notes.title: New Patch Available! Fixes & Improvements #1
notes.content:
Ahoy Fellow Pirates!

You can now access new build of Ruiga Pirates (v0.75.3).

To discuss please join the official Discord!

Full changelog:

 Mouse scroll problems on pre-play page fixed.
 Opening Scene bug fixed.
 Bugged Achievements fixed
 Frigate, Fast Galleon and War Galleon deleted.
 Game speed increased and enemy stats balanced.
 Wind negative effects deleted.
 Wind feature balanced.
 Wind VFX changed.
 Indicators improved.
 Localization improved.


Thank you for keep fighting against pirates!

Valentware Team

notes.title: Update Time! v0.24.4 Demo Out!
notes.content:
Ahoy, Pirates! Set Sail with the Latest Update!

Exciting news awaits you on the high seas - Ruiga Pirates has just released a new update, packed with enhancements to elevate your piracy experience. Here's the update list:


 Quests of Island: Island ahead! And ready for plunder, raze or maybe save it. Who knows?
 Shiny Chest: If you feel lucky enough, you can find chests now! 
 New Seas a Shore: Totally new and much more different sea texture added with tasty shaders.
 Plunder-Ready Weaponry: Values for your trusty weapons have been fine-tuned, providing a fairer chance for victory in every skirmish.
 New Weapons for the Arsenal: Discover exciting new additions to your pirate arsenal! Unleash fresh tactics on your adversaries.
 Gameplay Enhancements: We've fine-tuned the overall gameplay, making each seafaring adventure more thrilling and immersive.
 Player-Driven Improvements: Thanks to your valuable feedback, we've implemented a series of improvements to make the game even more pirate-tastic. Your voice matters!


 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719367/8aafbd52b7e09f4a8278a4b501298e7fc8a85999.png 

And the most exciting part: This Version is as a Free Demo! As we continue to chart our course through the development seas, we're offering this update as a free demo. Your feedback will be the guiding star.

We Crave Your Ideas! For further adventures, we need your comments. Share your experiences and ideas with us.

Follow Us and Add to Your Wishlist! KYour support makes the wind fill our sails!

Thank you, and may your plundering be bountiful!

Valentware Games

notes.title: Live Stream with New Update!
notes.content:
Ahoy, Shipmates!

Set sail with us on an exciting adventure as we announce a live stream you won't want to miss! Join us as we unveil the latest update for Ruiga Pirates Demo and embark on thrilling new journeys on the high seas.

📺 Stream Link: In Our Lovely Store Page

During the live stream, we'll showcase the fantastic new features and improvements we've added to the game, including a pre-game selection screen, the ability to choose from different ships, and even select different captains to lead your crew to glory. It's a pirate's dream come true!

But that's not all - we'll also be taking your questions and feedback, so make sure to tune in and let your voice be heard.

Don't forget to invite your fellow buccaneers and join our lively Discord community for some pre-stream banter and to connect with other captains.

And last but not least, help us chart the course for even greater adventures! Add Ruiga Pirates to your Steam wishlist and be the first to know about upcoming updates and features.

notes.title: New Update! Demo v0.15 Here!
notes.content:
Hello, Mateys!

Your pirate brethren are hard at work, and today, we've received feedback from some of you on various matters. These feedbacks are so important for us, so don't forget to discuss them on the Steam discussion board.

Furthermore, don't forget to join our Discord server, where you can reach us more easily and chat with fellow captains.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719367/8aafbd52b7e09f4a8278a4b501298e7fc8a85999.png 

New Features:

 Pre-game selection screen added.
 Different ships can now be selected.
 Different captains can now be chosen.


Fixes:

 Control issues have been addressed.
 Certain button bugs have been fixed.
 Map scaling has been updated.


With all this in mind, our updates will continue to roll out. Add the game to your wishlist and stay tuned. Be the first to know about the latest features!
